# Non-BYZ dedup fallback pulse for Slot 77 (oe_pplc_).
# When BYZ scheduler Slot 77 runs first, oe_pplc_ran_m == oe_ml_month_now so this trigger short-circuits in O(1).
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_pplc_fallback_pulse } }

oe_pplc_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_pplc_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			AND = { is_ai = no oe_pplc_is_host = yes }
			tag = PLC
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:PLC } tag = POL }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:PLC } NOT = { country_exists = c:POL } tag = LIT }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_pplc_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}
